messages:
maria_fin: Hi @diego_vendor — we received invoice 2026-045 but it's missing the CFDI digital stamp (UUID). Mexico's SAT requires a stamped CFDI for IVA credit. Can you resend the XML/PDF with the fiscal UUID and confirm your RFC? Also confirm whether IVA (16% or 0%) was charged and if there's any ISR withholding applied.

diego_vendor: Hey Maria, sorry about that. We'll generate the stamped CFDI now. Our RFC is ACME800101XYZ. The invoice currently shows IVA 16%. We'll attach the XML + PDF in a sec. Do you need a special note about "Operación exenta" or reverse charge?

sam_tax: Quick q — who was billed on the invoice (Redwood US or Redwood MX)? That changes IVA/withholding treatment. Also, if they charged IVA incorrectly, we may need them to reissue.

maria_fin: Billed to Redwood Inc (US entity). Payment coming from our US AP. Vendor billed us with IVA which surprised AP. If services were provided outside MX then IVA shouldn't apply, right? Need legal/tax confirmation.

invoicebot: :warning: Payment blocked: missing compliant tax documentation (CFDI) — hold until XML attached.

diego_vendor: Just uploaded the files: https://files.acme.example/cfdi-uuid-9f8a7b6c.xml and PDF attached to this thread. The XML includes the UUID and sello.

sam_tax: Received. I'll validate the CFDI quickly (checking Comprobante -> TipoDeComprobante and Traslados). If CFDI shows "exportación" or "traslado 0%" we can accept without reclaim. If they incorrectly charged 16%, ask for a corrected invoice (Nota de Crédito) or reissue without IVA.

maria_fin: AP: can you keep the payment on hold until we confirm? @jess_ops can you run this by legal/tax counsel and confirm whether we should ask vendor to reissue without IVA or whether we should gross-up for any Mexican withholding?

jess_ops: On it. I just pinged external counsel, will get back with a firm answer by EOD. If counsel says IVA was charged in error, we'll request nota de crédito; if not, we'll discuss gross-up vs net payment.

sam_tax: FYI if vendor expects gross-up for ISR withholding, that needs contract approval. For now, hold payment and don't agree to any gross-up until counsel confirms.

maria_fin: Thanks everyone — will wait for counsel. Diego, we'll follow up once we know if a nota de crédito is needed. :thumbsup:
